newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $2.01 bln week of Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $2.01 bln week of Sept 23.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.01 billion in 89 offerings for the week of Sept 23, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales for the week are expected to total about $444 million in 37 offerings. The largest issue a $170 million District of Columbia issue.

Negotiated sales, depending on market conditions, could total $1.572 billion in 52 offerings for the week. The largest issue is expected to be a $144 million Port of Portland, Ore., issue through Goldman Sachs & Co.

An additional $388 billion of deals in 10 issues are on the Reuters day-to-day negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
